title: Hampel Filter
text: Filter outliers using Hampel identifier, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough; {Window length} sets the length of sliding window, {Specify threshold from input port} sets the flag to specify threshold, {Threshold for outlier detection (standard deviations)}, {Output outlier status} sets the flag to output the outlier status and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: T
ports.summary: Threshold real scalar greater than or equal to 0

ports.name: outlier
ports.summary: Output the outlier status vector | matrix

params.name: Window length
params.values: Length of sliding window 11 (default) | positive odd scalar integer

params.name: Specify threshold from input port
params.values: Flag to specify threshold off (default) | on

params.name: Threshold for outlier detection (standard deviations)
params.values: Threshold 3 (default) | real scalar greater than or equal to 0

params.name: Output outlier status
params.values: Flag to output the outlier status off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
